description: Dry-run an order and mint a one-time confirm_token (valid 10 minutes). Returns a human-readable purchase summary for the buyer to approve, plus the one-time token that create_order requires. Creates no order and reserves no funds.

coin.description: Payment coin, e.g. USDC, USDT, BTC, SOL

denomination_label.description: Exact denomination label (e.g. "100 USD", "60 UC", "1 GB 7 days")

dynamic.description: true for dynamic-range amounts, false for fixed denomination labels

network.description: Exact network string from get_price/networks, e.g. "Solana", "Tron", "ETH Mainnet"

phone.description: Phone number to recharge (REQUIRED for mobile top-ups, with country code)

name: validate_order

confirm_token.description: One-time token for create_order, valid 10 minutes

estimate.description: true = indicative only; exact amount fixed at order creation

feePct.description: Fee percent over USD face value (0 for volatile coins)

payAmount.description: Amount to pay in the chosen coin

summary.description: Human-readable purchase summary — show to the user for approval

title: Prepare order for approval
